# Sticky

> Sticky turns a Juicebox project token into a streak. Stick tokens to start a clock;
> unstick and the clock resets to zero and a configured share of what you withdraw stays
> behind, backing everyone still stuck. There is no lockup and no admin: the terms are
> fixed by the hook the project deployed.

## How to read this site as an agent

The app is hash-routed and renders in the browser, so fetching any route returns the
same shell. There is no server-rendered per-project page and no JSON API — every number
comes from direct JSON-RPC reads the browser makes against the project's chain.

## Routes (hash fragments, resolved in the browser)

- `#/` — sticky tokens ranked by amount stuck.
- `#/project/<projectId>` — one sticky token: what is stuck, who is streaking, the bonus
  left behind by unsticking. Child routes `#/project/<id>/tokens` and `#/project/<id>/airdrops`.
- `#/@<handle>` — the same sticky token by the project's verified ENS handle. The handle
  resolves only when the JBProjectHandles registry confirms the project's owner claimed
  it, so it names exactly one project.
- `#/account/<address>` — one account's streaks across sticky tokens.

## Vocabulary

- **Stick / unstick** — deposit or withdraw the project token. Unsticking is newest tranche first.
- **Streak** — how long an account has held a non-zero stuck balance. It resets only at zero.
- **Bonus** — the share of each unstick that stays in the pool, raising what every remaining
  sticky token is backed by.

## Source

- Hook and distributor contracts: https://github.com/mejango/jbsticky
- Protocol contracts: https://github.com/Bananapus/version-6
